content:
We need DBE for C14H20O5. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring O, S, halogens). No N. So DBE = 14 - 20/2 + 1 = 14 -10 +1 =5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to be safe, we can call retrieve_dbe_formula to get formula. Not necessary but okay. Use tool.
